tools.description: Search bookable hotels by location and dates. Returns hotels with nightly prices, photos, coordinates, a `url` linking to the hotel on Pilot, and an opaque id to pass to get_hotel_details and get_rates. tools.name: get_hotel_details
tools.description: Get static details (description, amenities, photos, address) for a hotel id returned by search_hotels.

tools.name: get_room_rates_for_hotel
tools.description: Get room rates for a hotel id from search_hotels. Each offer includes a price, board type and refundability. Booking is not available through this connector; send the user to Pilot to book.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_hotels · Public sink: get_room_rates_for_hotel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_hotels · Public sink: get_room_rates_for_hotel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
